dialogue_texts: Whoa, look at the sky! The magic density out here is off the charts.
It's like a giant, glowing target right over that Shirogane Manor!
Don't get too excited, My Majesty.
That "glow" is unstable glohm energy bleeding through the space-time fabric.
If you try to harvest that blindly, it'll blow us both to pieces.
Stray variables... Intruders tracking dirt across the threshold of a flawless equation.
Well, look what the storm dragged in. You're practically dripping with that weird energy.
Mind if I take a closer look at those spatial formulas of yours?
My Majesty, don't! Helene Black is completely overtaken by the glohm.
Her core is fluctuating wildly. She won't listen to you.
An ordinary mind cannot comprehend the calibration.
The axes must be shattered so the true foundation can rise.
"Ordinary," huh? I get that a lot.
But you see, when a math problem gets in my way, I don't solve it.
I just blast a hole right through the middle of it!
Let's see how your precious foundation holds up against a little firepower!
Let me see if your amulets can withstand the pressure of the glohm!
